mechanism: Bumetanide-induced electrolyte depletion and volume depletion may increase susceptibility to infliximab-associated infections and compromised immune response; infliximab increases infection risk which may be compounded by loop diuretic-induced immunosuppression.
action: Monitor electrolytes and fluid status closely; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte replacement; monitor for signs of infection; consider alternative diuretics if possible or adjust bumetanide dosing based on clinical response.
